goodsReceipt.title: Goods receipts
goodsReceipt.noWorkspace: Pick a workspace to view goods receipts.
goodsReceipt.selectHint: Select a receipt to see its lines and its trail.
goodsReceipt.noLines: No lines yet. Add one from the order's open quantity.
goodsReceipt.dateIsFixed: The receipt date is fixed when it is opened: every stock movement carries it, and a locked period refuses the post.

error.transport: Could not load the goods receipts. Please try again.

empty.title: No goods receipts yet
empty.hint: Send a purchase order first, then record what arrives against it here.

overReceipt.line: {qty} more than the order had open

goodsReceipt.overReceiptHint: An over-delivery is accepted and recorded here rather than refused: the goods are in the warehouse either way. Set a hard ceiling in the settings if you want it blocked instead.

form.hold: Hold for inspection (no stock until accepted)
form.newLotHint: The lot number from the delivery note. A purchased lot usually comes into existence right here, on its first delivery.
form.serialHint: A serial is a single unit, so a serial line receives 1.
form.serialReturnHint: Serials that are not at a location right now: ones already on the shelf are left out, because receiving a unit twice would count it twice.

errors.nothing_open: This order has nothing left to receive.
errors.qty_exceeds_open: More than the order still has open. Reduce the quantity, or allow over-receipt in the settings.
errors.over_receipt: Above the over-receipt tolerance this workspace allows. Reduce the quantity or raise the tolerance.
errors.line_already_billed: A vendor bill has already been matched against this line, so it cannot be reversed.
errors.location_required: Pick a location for this line: the goods have to land somewhere.
errors.period_locked: The period this receipt belongs to is locked. Unlock it first, in Periods.
errors.insufficient_stock: The goods have already left the warehouse, so this receipt cannot be reversed. Record an inventory adjustment instead.
errors.invalid_transition: That is not possible in the receipt's current state.
errors.invalid_qty: Check the quantity: a whole number above zero, and exactly 1 on a line that names a serial.
errors.lot_required: This item is lot-tracked: pick a lot for the line, or enter the lot number from the delivery note.
errors.serial_required: This item is serial-tracked: pick a serial for the line, or enter the serial number from the delivery note.
errors.tracking_not_applicable: That item is not lot- or serial-tracked, so it cannot carry one.
errors.lot_number_taken: That lot number already exists for this item. Pick it from the list instead.
errors.serial_number_taken: That serial number already exists for this item.

GoodsReceipt.title: Goods receipts
GoodsReceipt.body: Goods receipts record what actually arrived against an order: lines with quantity, cost value, location and inspection state. A draft can be edited and posted; a posted receipt is immutable and is reversed when needed. Every recognised line mints its own stock movement carrying the document’s date, and a closed period accepts no further posting.
